observations.title: Mark old event invitations as archived
observations.observed: The 2010-dated event URL still displays an invitation to reserve a place for July 15. The article body shows no year or archived-event notice.
observations.improvement: Add the event year and a past-event label, linking to current contact or event information. Retain the historical page without an outdated reservation prompt.

observations.title: Review the first-visit intake burden
observations.observed: The client form requires a Texas driver's-license number alongside address and contact details; optional employment and partner-employment fields appear before pet details.
observations.improvement: Discuss essential first-step details, grouped sections and a clear explanation of identity-data handling. Measure completion before changing the full intake.

limitations: The client form was visible; submission and delivery were not tested.
This covers website/intake usability, not clinical care, legal compliance or a security audit.
Public website review only. No forms submitted or mobile-usability, conversion, speed or internal-system tests performed.
